purpose: test whether complementary frozen/reference and raw-evidence models add value when combined without test-set tuning
evidence: reuse frozen V32.2 evidence_v2 bytes only
chronology: reuse V32.2 five expanding train/calibration/test folds with 28h purge

stacking.transform: convex blend in logit probability space
stacking.weights: separate fixed weight per family x line x fold

v3_replay.scope: all calibration/test fixtures on the V32.3 venue-supported panel where the exact V3 contract is reconstructible
v3_replay.history: same competition only, strictly prior matches
v3_replay.prior_season_calibration: fit only from prior seasons available before target; no future-season knowledge
v3_replay.calibration: inherit frozen V3 prior-season Platt calibration
v3_replay.unsupported: fail closed and exclude symmetrically from all compared arms

goals.decision_rule: retain stack as future prospective challenger only if it improves paired test log loss and Brier versus both parents without materially worse calibration; interior calibration weights are supporting evidence of complementarity, not sufficient alone

corners.decision_rule: retain stack as future prospective challenger only if it improves paired test log loss and Brier versus both parents and calibration is not materially degraded

uncertainty: paired ISO-week block bootstrap, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 3400
promotion: none from exposed development outcomes; any retained stack must be frozen prospectively
